svg.title: Mona Lisa - sfumato study in pure vector strokes
svg.desc: Research copy after Leonardo da Vinci, Mona Lisa (c.1503-1506, Musee du Louvre). Rendered entirely from hand-organized short arc strokes and tapered strokes simulating oil glazing and sfumato. No bitmaps, no photo fills, no smooth color transitions as substitutes for form: every form is built from layered vector brush strokes. Reference: Wikimedia Commons, public domain (PD-Art / PD-old-100-expired / CC-PD-Mark-1.0).
